delivery_legend.digital: Fully teachable on screen. The engine serves these.
delivery_legend.parent_guided: Physical-world learning. The app shows the parent an activity card and records completion — it does NOT fake a tap question for it.
delivery_legend.hybrid: Screen introduces it, a physical action completes it.

topics.title: Shapes
topics.objective: Identify circles, squares, triangles and rectangles
topics.intro_message: Let us look at shapes more closely today.

activities.prompt: Tap the circle.
Tap the triangle.
Which one has all four sides the SAME length?
activities.hint: A square is equal on every side.

activities.prompt: Which one is longer than it is tall?
Which object is shaped like a rectangle?
activities.hint: Tall and straight on all sides.

topics.title: Count to 3
topics.objective: Count dots, shapes and objects up to 3; read and show ten frames
topics.intro_message: Let us start small. One, two, three!

activities.prompt: Count the dots.
Count the triangles.
How many squares are filled on the ten frame?
Which ten frame shows 2?
activities.hint: Count the filled boxes in each.

topics.title: Count to 5
topics.objective: Count and represent numbers up to 5
topics.intro_message: Now let us count to five, like the fingers on your hand!

activities.prompt: Count the stars.
How many boxes are filled?
activities.hint: The whole top row is full.

activities.prompt: Which number shows how many apples there are?
activities.hint: Count first, then find the number.

activities.prompt: Match the number 5 to the right group.

topics.title: Count to 10
topics.objective: Count and represent numbers up to 10
topics.intro_message: Ten fingers, ten toes. Let us count to ten!

activities.prompt: Count the birds.
activities.hint: Count in a line, left to right.

activities.prompt: How many boxes are filled on the ten frame?
Tap the number 8.
activities.hint: Eight looks like two circles stacked up.

activities.prompt: Which group has 10 things?
How many dots altogether?
activities.hint: Count in twos if it helps.

topics.title: Comparing
topics.objective: Compare groups by counting; fewer, more, enough
topics.intro_message: Is there enough for everyone? Let us check!

activities.prompt: There are 3 children and 3 chairs. Is there a chair for everyone?
activities.hint: Match one chair to each child.

activities.prompt: There are 4 dogs and 2 bones. Is there a bone for every dog?
Which group has FEWER?
There are 6 red balls and 4 blue balls. Which colour has more?
In this mixed group, how many are stars?
activities.hint: Count only the stars, skip the rest.

topics.title: Positions
topics.objective: Inside/outside, above/below, beside, left/right, top/middle/bottom
topics.intro_message: Let us learn where things are.

activities.prompt: Is the ball inside or outside the basket?
activities.hint: The ball is not in the basket.

activities.prompt: Which animal is BESIDE the tree?
activities.hint: Beside means right next to it.

activities.prompt: Which hand is your LEFT hand?
activities.hint: Hold up both hands and think.

activities.prompt: Which toy is in the MIDDLE?
activities.hint: The one between the other two.

activities.prompt: Which book is at the BOTTOM of the pile?
activities.hint: The one holding all the others up.

topics.title: Classify
topics.objective: Sort by colour and by shape; same and different
topics.intro_message: Let us sort things into groups.

activities.prompt: Which two are the SAME?
Find all the yellow shapes.
activities.hint: Ignore the shape, look at the colour.

activities.prompt: Find all the circles.
activities.hint: Ignore the colour, look at the shape.

activities.prompt: Which square is red?
activities.hint: Both are squares — look at the colour.

topics.title: Size
topics.objective: Long/short, tall/short, light/heavy, wide/narrow
topics.intro_message: Let us compare how big things are.

activities.prompt: Which snake is LONGER?
activities.hint: Follow each one from end to end.

activities.prompt: Which building is TALLER?
activities.hint: Tall goes up towards the sky.

activities.prompt: Which one is LIGHTER?
activities.hint: Light things are easy to lift.

activities.prompt: Which road is WIDE?
activities.hint: Wide has lots of space across.

topics.title: Money
topics.objective: Recognise coin values and count 1-rupee coins
topics.intro_message: Let us learn about coins!

activities.prompt: Which coin is 1 rupee?
activities.hint: Look for the number 1 on it.

activities.prompt: How many 1-rupee coins are here?
You have 4 one-rupee coins. How many rupees is that?

topics.title: Capital Letters (A-Z)
topics.objective: Identify and link an object to every capital letter
topics.intro_message: A to Z — let us learn them all!
topics.generation_rule: For each letter L in A-Z emit two activities: select_letter (L against two distractors) and object-match (which object starts with L). Writing lives in lkg_art_writing. 26 x 2 = 52 activities.

activities.prompt: Tap the letter A.
activities.hint: A looks like a tent with a belt.

activities.prompt: Which one starts with A?
Tap the letter M.
Which one starts with M?
Which letter is missing? D, E, ?, G
activities.hint: Sing the alphabet song from D.

topics.title: Small Letters (a-z)
topics.objective: Small letters, capital-small matching, vowels, phonic drill, vowel words, rhyming
topics.intro_message: Now the small letters, and the words they make!
topics.generation_rule: For each letter a-z emit select_letter and a capital-small match. Writing lives in lkg_art_writing. 26 x 2 = 52 activities.

activities.prompt: Which small letter goes with D?
activities.hint: The tummy is on the right.

activities.prompt: Which small letter goes with G?
activities.hint: It has a tail that curls left.

activities.prompt: Which of these is a VOWEL?
activities.hint: The vowels are a, e, i, o, u.

activities.prompt: Fill the gap: c _ t (a cat says meow)
Fill the gap: p _ g (it says oink)
Which word rhymes with SUN?
Say the sounds: a, e, i, o, u.

topics.title: Phonetics & Early Grammar
topics.objective: Article a/an, this-that, these-those, one-many, positions, rhyming
topics.intro_message: Let us put words together to make sense!

activities.prompt: Choose the right word: ___ apple
activities.hint: Use 'an' before a, e, i, o, u.

activities.prompt: Choose the right word: ___ ball
The cat is near you. Do you say THIS cat or THAT cat?
activities.hint: 'This' is for near, 'that' is for far.

activities.prompt: The birds are far away. Do you say THESE birds or THOSE birds?
One cat, many ___?
activities.hint: Add an 's' for more than one.

activities.prompt: One box, many ___?

topics.title: About Myself
topics.objective: Body parts, family, birthday, home and school
topics.intro_message: Let us talk about you and your world.

activities.prompt: How many eyes do we have?
Which part do we use to walk?
Who is your father's father?
What do we cut on a birthday?
Where do we keep our books at school?
activities.hint: You carry it on your back.

topics.title: Safety
topics.objective: Safety at home, on the road and at the playground
topics.intro_message: Being safe means being careful. Let us learn how.

activities.prompt: Where should we walk on a busy road?
Whose hand should we hold when crossing the road?
Should we play with matches?
Should we push others on the slide?

topics.title: People Who Help Us
topics.objective: Doctor, teacher, policeman, postman, carpenter, farmer
topics.intro_message: Let us meet the helpers in our town.

activities.prompt: Who gives us medicine when we are ill?
activities.hint: You visit them at a clinic.

activities.prompt: Who makes chairs and tables from wood?
activities.hint: They use a hammer and saw.

activities.prompt: Who keeps us safe and directs traffic?
Which tool belongs to the farmer?
activities.hint: It is used in the field.

topics.title: Transport
topics.objective: Road, rail and air transport
topics.intro_message: Let us go on a journey!

activities.prompt: Which of these travels by AIR?
activities.hint: It has spinning blades on top.

activities.prompt: Which of these travels by RAIL?
How many wheels does a cycle have?
Which one carries many people on the road?
activities.hint: It is big and has many seats.

topics.title: Seasons
topics.objective: Summer, winter and rainy season
topics.intro_message: The year has different seasons. Let us meet them.

activities.prompt: Which season do we wear light clothes and drink cold water?
Which season do we wear a woollen cap?
Which of these do we use in the rainy season?

topics.title: Animals
topics.objective: Wild, domestic, water and pet animals
topics.intro_message: Animals live in many different places!

activities.prompt: Which animal is WILD?
Which animal is DOMESTIC?
Which animal lives in WATER?
activities.hint: It swims and has a shell.

activities.prompt: Which animal do we keep as a PET at home?
Where does a bird live?
activities.hint: It is built in a tree.

topics.title: Good Habits & Manners
topics.objective: Everyday good habits and polite manners
topics.intro_message: Good habits make everyone happy.

activities.prompt: What should we do with waste paper?
What do we say before asking for something?
How many times a day should we brush our teeth?

topics.title: Living & Non-Living
topics.objective: Sort living from non-living things
topics.intro_message: Some things are alive. Let us find out which!

activities.prompt: Which of these is LIVING?
activities.hint: Living things grow and need water.

activities.prompt: Which of these is NON-LIVING?
activities.hint: It cannot move on its own.

activities.prompt: Collect three living and three non-living things with a grown-up.
activities.hint: A leaf is living, a spoon is not.
activities.parent_note: Lay them in two piles and ask the child to explain each choice. The reasoning matters more than the sorting.

topics.title: Traffic Rules & Body Parts
topics.objective: Traffic signals and naming parts of the body
topics.intro_message: Rules keep us safe, and our body helps us follow them!

activities.prompt: What does a YELLOW light mean?
activities.hint: It comes between red and green.

activities.prompt: Where do people cross the road safely?
activities.hint: The white stripes on the road.

activities.prompt: Which part of the body do we use to hold things?

topics.title: Pre-Writing Strokes
topics.objective: Standing, sleeping, slanting lines and all four curves
topics.intro_message: Strong lines make strong letters!

activities.prompt: Trace the standing line.
activities.hint: Top to bottom, nice and straight.

activities.prompt: Trace the sleeping line.
Trace the left slanting line.
Trace the right slanting line.
Trace the up curve.
Trace the down curve.

topics.title: Letter Writing
topics.objective: Write the capital and small letters with a finger
topics.intro_message: Now let us write! Follow the shape with your finger.
topics.generation_rule: For each letter emit one trace of the capital and one of the small letter. Only A is authored so far; the rest of the alphabet is still to be written.

activities.prompt: Write the letter A.
